compiled_state.title: Add _audit_dso_id_label_writes guard called from apply() per-leaf
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-4: Static guard in applier matrix raises DsoIdLabelWriteError if any path attempts dso-id label write outside two authorized paths

Implement _audit_dso_id_label_writes(leaf_name: str, mutations: list[Mutation]) -> None in applier.py: if leaf_name not in _AUTHORIZED_DSO_ID_LABEL_WRITERS and any mutation has target=='label' AND payload.startswith('dso-id-') AND action in {'create','update'} -> raise DsoIdLabelWriteError(leaf_name, offending_mutation). Wire into apply() so it executes AFTER every leaf returns its mutation list, BEFORE mutations commit downstream. Authorized leaves pass unchanged. Sentinel test monkey-patches audit helper and asserts it's invoked once per leaf execution within single apply() call.

## Test Approach
Given unauthorized leaf 'inbound_update' + mutation list with one Mutation(target='label', payload='dso-id-abc123', action='create'); When _audit_dso_id_label_writes called; Then DsoIdLabelWriteError raised, message references offending leaf + payload. Sentinel: patched counter; When apply() runs across all 9 leaves; Then counter == 9.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py
- [ ] Unauthorized leaf attempting dso-id label write raises DsoIdLabelWriteError
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_unauthorized_leaf_raises_dso_id_label_write_error
- [ ] Authorized leaves (inbound_clean_label, outbound_create) pass audit without raising
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_authorized_leaves_pass_audit
- [ ] apply() invokes _audit_dso_id_label_writes once per leaf (sentinel)
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_apply_invokes_audit_for_every_leaf
- [ ] Non-dso-id label mutations from unauthorized leaves do not raise
  Verify: pytest tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py::test_audit_ignores_non_dso_id_label_mutations

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/applier.py — Edit
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_dso_id_label_writers.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Replace call-count sentinel test with BEHAVIORAL RED test. RED test design: (a) BEFORE wiring _audit_dso_id_label_writes into apply(): test_unauthorized_leaf_writes_dso_id_label_silently_succeeds — invoke apply() with mutation from unauthorized leaf that writes dso-id label → no exception, write proceeds (this is the RED state). (b) AFTER wiring: test_unauthorized_leaf_writes_dso_id_label_raises_through_apply — invoke apply() with same mutation → DsoIdLabelWriteError propagates through apply(). The behavioral observation (raise vs no-raise through apply()) is the RED-to-GREEN signal; do NOT use a call-count sentinel on the internal helper. Sentinel test demoted to supplementary — primary correctness assertion is via apply() integration.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1 CONFLICT_RESOLUTION (Stage 3 Safety/TDD strict_vs_flexible): TDD requirement prevails because this story's purpose IS establishing the contract — warn-only mode would defeat the guard at the moment it ships. Compromise: add config-gated mode parameter with default DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE='raise'. Override DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE='warn' available for staged rollout if production migration uncovers missed authorized paths. Tests assert default RAISE mode (RED test passes with raise; warn-mode override is config-only with structured warning log).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: (a) Guard scope expanded — _audit_dso_id_label_writes covers action in {create, update, DELETE} (not just create/update). Unauthorized DELETE of dso-id labels is also prohibited; only inbound_clean_label may delete dso-id labels. Closes the e2e_coverage gap from cycle 2. (b) RED test isolation: monkey-patch _load_acli to return a no-op stub client + patch _load_concurrency. Reference existing tests/unit/dso_reconciler/conftest.py baseline for fixture pattern. Ensures RED failure is deterministic (guard absent), not infra-noise. (c) DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE resolution order: read os.environ first; fallback to dso-config.conf key dso_id_guard_mode; env var takes precedence. Document precedence in module docstring.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: FINAL_REMEDIATION: Add warn-mode boundary test — DSO_DSO_ID_GUARD_MODE=warn + unauthorized write → no exception raised + warning logged (assert via caplog fixture or mock logger; assert log record level=WARNING, message contains 'DSO_ID_GUARD' and the offending leaf_name + payload). Add env-vs-config precedence test (closes dd_collective_ac_coverage gap from cycle 3): (a) env=warn + config=raise → warn behavior (env wins); (b) env=raise + config=warn → raise behavior (env wins); (c) env unset + config=warn → warn behavior (config fallback); (d) env unset + config unset → raise (default). 4 parametrized cases.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Guard MUST run on post-leaf, pre-execution mutation list (wrap per-leaf dispatch result) such that every leaf's emitted dso-id-* label mutation passes through the guard regardless of which leaf produced it. Add RED test: call apply() with an UNAUTHORIZED leaf returning a synthetic dso-id-* label mutation → DsoIdLabelWriteError raised. Without pinning the invocation site, future refactor could regress silently (implicit_assumption).
comments.author: Test
